# PortfolioSummaryCard

Wallet header with the address, total value and refresh status.

**Import**

```tsx
import { PortfolioSummaryCard } from '@/components/portfolio-summary-card'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | `string` | Yes | — | Wallet address, truncated for display. |
| `totalValue` | `number` | Yes | — | Total portfolio value in USD. |
| `change24h` | `number` | Yes | — | 24-hour percentage change. |
| `assetCount` | `number` | Yes | — | Number of assets held. |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | Yes | — | ISO timestamp of the last refresh; `null` renders "never". |
| `isRefreshing` | `boolean` | Yes | — | Shows the refreshing state and disables the refresh button. |
| `isLive` | `boolean` | Yes | — | Shows the live-updates indicator. |
| `hideAmounts` | `boolean` | No | `false` | Masks the total value. |
| `onToggleHideAmounts` | `() => void` | No | `undefined` | Flips the shared privacy preference. |
| `onRefresh` | `() => void` | Yes | — | Called when the refresh button is pressed. |

## Usage

```tsx
import { PortfolioSummaryCard } from '@/components/portfolio-summary-card'

export function Header() {
  return (
    <PortfolioSummaryCard
      address="GBKXNRTZQVD6CNOQNRZVMJVQ4ZQ5K..."
      totalValue={1046.9}
      change24h={1.24}
      assetCount={3}
      updatedAt={new Date().toISOString()}
      isRefreshing={false}
      isLive
      onRefresh={() => {}}
    />
  )
}
```
